audit.why: 45.76% over 3990 games is a losing lane; 7/10 difficulty is right. Only level 1 is yours (815 Q vs 800 Dark Sphere, one charge); from level 2 her Q into Scatter the Weak out-trades you.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side values disagreed with the content layer and the packet levelChart, and every phases[N].why was a generic Orianna template misgendering Syndra as 'he/his'.
audit.why: Packet chart and win[0..6] agree: Orianna, Syndra, Syndra, Syndra, Skill, Syndra, Syndra. The full layer read Syndra, Skill, Skill, Skill, Syndra, Skill, Skill — the page rendered two answers to every row.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer, ratings adjusted to the losing curve, and every why rewritten to explain the new verdict from this kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; the true-damage interaction from Transcendent-upgraded Force of Will was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s, Dark Sphere a flat 7s, Unleashed Power 120/100/80. Upgraded Force of Will deals bonus true damage, so magic resist is the wrong purchase against her poke.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns; the true-damage caveat written into spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable-cooldown window was stated with a number.
audit.why: Scatter the Weak on 15s flat is the single window: your Q drops from 7s to 3s while her Q stays 7s, so you gain a cast per rotation in its downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: 22 misgendered fields calling Syndra 'he/his', plus two Do's/Don'ts bullets that were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bleed bullets replaced with content matching their titles.
